title: A paper in one minute
text: What is the main question of a paper you recently read?

options.text: It uses a method related to my project.
options.response: 建立了联系，但还需要说清问题与结论。

options.text: It asks whether an intervention improves transfer, not just test scores. I found the distinction useful, although the sample was small.
options.response: 你交代了问题、价值和范围，而不是只复述论文标题。

options.text: It is a very famous paper published in a good journal.
options.response: 出版信息无法替代对研究问题的理解。
